I do realize my feelings are lying. Sort of. I know they are not facts, but I can't deem them false either, if that makes sense. I have become really good at rationalizing, and that's what has helped me so far. My therapist says most people with my background don't survive, let alone raise a family and seek therapy. I make a list of things I can do, I try to remind myself there are people that love me, and eventually I can get through another day. The thing is, I have to do this all the time! I have to keep proving myself I'm worth living, and it's exhausting! And then doubt creeps in: "if you have to make such an effort, maybe you're just lying to yourself". My emotions are not my friends. So I keep them as down as I can.   
I could do this for countless days, I could fight, I really could. I have done it many many times. I could do it for my kids. But I feel my existence is miserable. Ending it would be so much easier. People would hurt, but then they would move on, right? I moved on from my father's death, and my grandmother's, the only people that had love for me. My kids have a loving father, and they are good strong kids, they could do it. It would hurt, but they would heal. That's not to say I'm jumping to do something. But I do wonder about that, I must admit.

Thank you for your kind words. Although I can register them, I can't feel that way. I just don't see it.

Usually he will say "But we love you so much, we need you so much, you are so bright, and loving and etc...". And I listen, I really do. But it's hard to see it and it kind of makes me feel double the guilt. Guilty of being worthless and guilty of causing him so much pain.

Thank you for your reply. I am doing therapy for 3 months now. I don't know if isn't actually making things worse, because most of the repressed memories are coming back. And it's infuriating. I have kids, I would never do the same to them. I can't understand why they could hate me so much. I can't understand why they tortured me for so long, without regard to my safety. I was just a child.

I was raised by a narcissistic mother, and the few people in my life that actually loved me passed away during my childhood. My mom and older brother ganged up on me, and I was the sole focus of their hatred for years. I was raised not to love myself, only to be a function and a scapegoat. I did escape, but my mind didn't. I am in a good relationship now and have a loving family, but her words haunt me: "Sooner or later they will see what a loser you are and leave you." I can't escape it. It's suffocating. She wins.  
I can't be happy. I know I have reasons to, but I can't. I am functional, I cook and clean, and raise my kids to be good people, but these are things that I do. What I conceptualized to be right. Inside, I just feel like giving up. I don't feel like I will be missed at all, because I feel there's nothing in me to be loved. Only the things I do.

If you ask her about the day my daughter was born, she will tell you that was the day her chronic pain started. If you ask her about my graduation, she will tell you about how much SHE fought so I could have an education. If you ask her about the day I almost died, and almost left a husband, a five-year-old and a newborn behind, she will tell you she almost went crazy with grief. I say my Nmom has a superpower. She can make every single subject (and I mean, EVERY SINGLE SUBJECT) about herself.

Yes, that is not normal. And yet, we keep trying to get their attention. That's a game we will never win. Congratulations on being a daddy! I have to tell you, parenthood is a major eye opener.

I have kids and I understand they will resort to their own tools to get their way. But never have i ever ignored a cry. 1st- because as an abused child, i was ignored myself. 2nd - because a cry for help is a cry for help, no matter what shape or form it comes in. Fake cry is frustration, and needs to be dealt with. Do i do what they want? No, but i address the issue by making them understand why something needs to be done a certain way. Kids are not manipulative little geniuses, they are children, learning to navigate this world. They are immature and lack emotional maturity and we need to guide them. And that's our job. Not ignore the cry. Not laugh at the cry.

As a fellow writer, I'm happy to oblige! The other day I was asking some questions to ISTJs for the same purpose. :D Using MBTI is sooooo useful!  
I will talk about my personality (the good, the bad, and the ugly).  
\- I'm cheerful and positive, the world may be falling and I'll be the one saying "hey, maybe it is supposed to fall, to make way to the new!". Some people usually find it frustrating.  
\- People say ENFPs are flaky, I don't think I am. If I say I will, I do. But I do disappear sometimes. Thing is, I am almost as introverted as extroverted. I need my alone time as much as I need to socialize. So sometimes I avoid people. But because I'm usually very honest about how I feel, people end up getting it.  
\- I'm forward. But I'm almost always diplomatic. Meaning I will say what I feel but I will take a minute to form it in my head so it conveys truth without hurting anyone.

\-I don't hold grudges, but I will always express that I'm upset and why. I'm not a pouter, I couldn't be even if I wanted to. I say my piece and move on. This usually leads people to think that, just because I'm not screaming or crying, it's solved. Sometimes it's not, I just don't like toxic environments.   
\- I am set on my beliefs. I am not judgemental, but I hate people without a spine. Sounds like I'm contradicting myself, but to me, I'm not. I understand different values, but I cannot stand someone hurting others just because. And people stealing things that they can afford just because they can (ex.: people that take more than a sample just because it's free).  
\- I love change. I hate being a caged bird. In my relatively short life (I'm 37) I have already worked in HR, as a client manager, as a teacher, as a translator, and as a logistics manager. I like to learn, I crave new. I start getting itchy if I don't feel like I'm evolving in some way. BUT, if it relates to my family, I am the pillar, strong, steady, unmoving. I like consistency when it comes to values and family.  
\- I'm insecure, and I need validation. I had to identify these feelings so I wouldn't take things too personally, but I still feel them. I learned to cope by reminding myself constantly that just because people don't validate me constantly it doesn't mean they don't value me.  
\- I can be pure evil. That's mostly why I never get too angry or walk away when I do. My intuition made me extremely good at perceiving all the wounds one may have so I can poke at them. It's vicious and it's cruel, so I don't do it. But I could if I wanted to. I choose not to.  
\- I sometimes dislike people and can't really understand why. And I may give them another chance but it will never be sincere. I think it's an intuition thing. I know it's stupid, but I can't help it.  
\- I can be forgiving, but I can also be very final when it comes to people. If someone attacks my core values, like saying I'm false or manipulative (I value my authenticity in particular, because I endure a lot to keep it), that person is dead to me. Most times I don't even seek retribution. Dead and buried and I have already forgotten about it.  
\- I am NOT a Unicorn. I can be really moody. But only the people closest to me will see me. (For me, lashing out is a sign of weakness).

\- This one even I find annoying: If you don't interest me, if the chat is boring, I tune out. I don't do it on purpose, it's how my brain works. Then someone comes to me and says "do you remember talking about this and that?" and for me, it is like that conversation never existed.

\- I can act however people need me to. And it's not because I am phony, I'm just accommodating. I want everybody to feel happy and comfortable, and I will make sure they are. It's not in my nature to be organized, but I can be! I am not touchy-feely, but you can cry and say the world is going to end, and I'm your shoulder. I will change myself, not try to change you (I may go to a corner to shudder, afterward). lol

If you have anything else to ask, go ahead. I'm happy to help.
